runner: offline LLM batch run, one run for each input pack
runs_note: A usage limit stopped some runs. 5 of them had already written a complete file. The others ran again.
input: results/merge_in/ (stage 1 output, packed by type and domain)
output_format: canonical_tag, type, domain, description, aliases, total_debate_count
special_pack: junk___plus3.tsv: one run decided again on the 96 rows that stage 1 called junk.
edited_after_run: No. All repairs after the run are in data/fixes_assembly.tsv.
